verdict.rationale: HumanLayer offers a CLI/automation path (humanlayer automation run, remote daemons, launch tokens) that lets AI-native users create and run tasks outside the UI, suggesting some parity, but there is no documented public API/OpenAPI spec (both llms.txt and openapi.json probes 404), and UI-only features like live multiplayer drafts, comment threads on synced documents, and keyboard-driven diff review show no CLI/API equivalents. missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API or OpenAPI spec, explicit API endpoints for comments/collaboration features, and confirmation that all UI actions (not just task launch) are scriptable.
